candidate_windows.window_text: We adopt the pre-trained language model BERT $^{4}$ (Devlin et al., 2019) as the backbone of our model, initialized from their pre-trained weights. The maximum document length is 512 due to BERT limitations, and documents are truncated to this size. The dimension of BERT-based representation is set to 768. For all datasets, we use the same hyperparameter, i.e., $\lambda = 0.9$
